name: Link External Provider to Current User
summary: Associates a validated, unlinked external provider subject with the currently authenticated durable user.

guards.expression: target durable identity is the current authenticated user
provider subject is not linked to another durable identity

sourceReferences.note: Approved policy requires provider-subject-first resolution and independent NuvIoT email proof before linking an unlinked provider to an existing durable user.
PendingIdentity defines OAuthExternalLogin as a ceremony-only flow bucket.
External IdP V2 reconciliation retains provider protocols as implementation details beneath provider-independent auth semantics.
AssociateExternalLoginAsync enforces target user id equals acting user id.
